title: The Crowns of the High Priest Joshua
description: The word of the Lord came to Zechariah: He is to receive silver and gold from the exiles – Heldai, Tobijah, and Jedaiah – and make crowns to be placed on the head of the high priest Joshua, son of Jehozadak. This is a sign pointing to a coming "Branch" who will build the Lord's temple, reign on his throne, and serve as priest, with the counsel of peace between these two offices [ref:Zech 6:9-15|Zechariah 6:9-15].
